instruction: Studio portrait, medium shot. Against a solid dusty rose wall, two women stand close. On the right, the woman with curly dark hair (R1) in a white shirt looks forward. On the left, the woman with straight dark hair (R2) in a denim jacket looks down, touching her hair. R1 places her hand gently on R2's shoulder. Soft side lighting illuminates the scene with warm, muted tones.
elements: R1 places her hand gently on R2's shoulder
R2 is the person receiving the shoulder touch from R1
R2 touches her own hair while R1's hand is on her shoulder
R1 looks forward while making shoulder contact with R2
the portrait is set against a solid dusty rose wall

questions.q: Is R1 placing her hand on R2's shoulder, rather than R2 placing her hand on R1's shoulder?
questions.element: R1 initiates the shoulder contact on R2

questions.q: Is R2 the woman whose shoulder is being gently touched by R1, rather than R1 being the one whose shoulder is touched by R2?
questions.element: R2 receives the shoulder touch from R1

questions.q: Does R2 touch her own hair while R1 keeps a hand on R2's shoulder?
questions.element: R2 touches her own hair while receiving R1's shoulder contact

questions.q: Does R1 look forward while she is the one making shoulder contact with R2?
questions.element: R1 looks forward while placing her hand on R2's shoulder
